item.title: The daily tape · 18 August 2026
item.description: Weekday briefing: country conversion already on The Wire, plus today's Silicon Tape display prints. Labeled terms only. This is not a 7-day move sheet. Countries: United States: NVIDIA 8-K (17 Aug 2026): residual-value guaranties on PORTS-Pike, ~4.25 IT-GW, OpenAI 20-year lease. Conversion as land-power-shell finance. Source: SEC. India: L&T × Together AI (13 Aug 2026): 10,000 B300s at Chennai; Phase 1 sized at 250 MW. Source: The Hindu Business Line / Reuters. Armenia: Firebird Hrazdan factory live (8 Aug 2026): NVIDIA/Dell, roadmap 70k+ GPUs and 300 MW by end-2027. Source: NVIDIA blog. Indonesia: Indosat Zankore (7 Aug 2026): 1 GW platform; first 200 MW GB300-class targeted H1 2027. Source: Data Center Dynamics.
